The app recognises spoken words, not signs. Write these parts of the text as words, the way your child will read them aloud.

Write them out in full. For example: e.g.\u00A0→ for example, USA\u00A0→ United States.
Replace signs with words. For example: %\u00A0→ percent, &\u00A0→ and.

Words read correctly are taken for mistakes less often, but a misreading that sounds like a word of the text may be missed. Applies from the next reading.

Read With Kid helps children practise reading aloud. The app is built so that no personal data leaves your phone.

Microphone and audio. While a child reads, the app listens through the microphone and recognises speech on this phone. Audio is processed in memory only: it is never recorded, saved or sent anywhere.

Data on the phone. The texts you add and their reading results are stored only in the app on this phone. They are not backed up and not shared with anyone. You can delete them in the app at any time; uninstalling the app deletes all of them.

Internet. The app goes online only to download speech models through Google Play; Google's privacy policy applies to these downloads. The app contains no advertising, no analytics and no tracking, and it collects no data, neither for us nor for third parties.

Children. The app is meant for children together with their parents. The app contains no links to websites.

Changes. If this policy changes, the new version will be shown in the app.
The app is built with open-source software and speech models. Their licences are reproduced below in their original English wording.
